### cell numbers in the pool (demuxafy assignment)
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=8}
# DEBUG
# save.image("temp/report.subpage_pools.debug.RData")
# stop("DEBUG forced stop")

# sum <- sum(subpage_data$number_of_cells[!subpage_data$sample_id %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")])
# subpage_data$frac <- subpage_data$number_of_cells/sum
# subpage_data$sample_id <- factor(subpage_data$sample_id)

subpage_data %>% 
  select(sample_id, number_of_cells) %>%
  filter(sample_id != "doublet" & sample_id != "unassigned") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, -number_of_cells), y = number_of_cells, fill = sample_id), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.8, size=3) +
  scale_y_continuous() +
  #geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype='dotted', col = 'red') + 
  #annotate("text", x = "PBMC_spike", y = 0.052, label = "Expected PBMC fraction", vjust = -0.5, size = 3) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust=1), legend.title = element_text(size=2), legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("Number of cells") +
  xlab("sample_id")
```

Row 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------
### cell fractions in the pool (demuxafy assignment)
```{r fig.height=3, fig.width=8}
sum <- sum(subpage_data$number_of_cells[!subpage_data$sample_id %in% c("doublet", "unassigned")])
subpage_data$frac <- subpage_data$number_of_cells/sum
subpage_data$sample_id <- factor(subpage_data$sample_id)

subpage_data %>% 
  select(sample_id, frac) %>%
  filter(sample_id != "doublet" & sample_id != "unassigned") %>%
  # TODO: fix ordering by fraction
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(sample_id, -frac), y = frac, fill = sample_id), show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_bar(stat="identity", width=0.8, size=3) +
  #facet_grid(. ~ Pool) + 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.05, linetype='dotted', col = 'red') + 
  # TODO: generalise PBMC specific spikein (or if there any at all used)
  annotate("text", x = "PBMC", y = 0.052, label = "Expected spike-in fraction", vjust = -0.5, size = 2) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust=1), legend.title = element_text(size=2), legend.position = "none") + 
  ylab("Fraction of cells") +
  xlab("sample_id")
```

### Total number of cells 
```{r}
expected_cells <- sum(subpage_data$possible_live_cells)
print(paste("Number of cells expected in the pool:", expected_cells))

total_cells <- subpage_data %>% 
  filter(sample_id!="doublet" & sample_id!="unassigned")
sum_total_cells <- sum(total_cells$number_of_cells)
print(paste("Total number of cells captured in the pool:", sum_total_cells))
